title: Exponential Nondeterministic Time Is in NEXP
statement: For every natural number $c$, $\mathrm{NTIME}(n\mapsto 2^{n^c})\subseteq\mathrm{NEXP}$. Here $\mathrm{NEXP}$ consists of languages for which there are natural numbers $C,c$ and a language $V\in\mathrm{P}$ such that membership of a string $x$ is equivalent to the existence of a string $u$ of length $C\cdot 2^{(|x|+1)^c}$ with $xu\in V$.
replaced: For every natural number $c$, the class $\mathrm{NTIME}(2^{n^c})$ is contained in the certificate-form class $\mathrm{NEXP}$: every language decided by some nondeterministic Turing machine within $a \cdot 2^{n^c}$ steps admits a polynomial-time verifier with certificates of exact length $a \cdot 2^{(n+1)^c}$.
